description: This file handles tag objects within a version control system, including verification, dereferencing, parsing, and lookup functionalities related to tags and their associated objects.

methods.name: int run_gpg_verify(const char * buf,unsigned long size,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Verifies the GPG signature of a buffer with optional verbose output.

methods.name: int gpg_verify_tag(const struct object_id * oid,const char * name_to_report,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a tag object given its object ID.

methods.name: struct:object * deref_tag(struct repository * r,struct object * o,const char * warn,int warnlen)
methods.description: Dereferences a tag to its underlying object, optionally warning if the tag is missing.

methods.name: struct:tag * lookup_tag(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Looks up a tag object by its object ID, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: timestamp_t parse_tag_date(const char * buf,const char * tail)
methods.description: Parses the date from a tag object buffer.

methods.name: void release_tag_memory(struct tag * t)
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a tag object.

methods.name: int parse_tag_buffer(struct repository * r,struct tag * item,const void * data,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Parses a tag object from raw data buffer.

methods.name: int parse_tag(struct tag * item)
methods.description: Ensures the tag object is fully parsed.

methods.name: struct:object_id * get_tagged_oid(struct tag * tag)
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID of the object referenced by the tag.

ctags.name: deref_tag
ctags.pattern: /^struct object *deref_tag(struct repository *r, struct object *o, const char *warn, int warnlen)$/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct object * o,const char * warn,int warnlen)

ctags.name: gpg_verify_tag
ctags.signature: (const struct object_id * oid,const char * name_to_report,unsigned flags)

ctags.name: parse_tag_buffer
ctags.pattern: /^int parse_tag_buffer(struct repository *r, struct tag *item, const void *data, unsigned long siz/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct tag * item,const void * data,unsigned long size)

ctags.name: run_gpg_verify
ctags.pattern: /^static int run_gpg_verify(const char *buf, unsigned long size, unsigned flags)$/
